# <span id="aanchor493"></span> Report Status

FLOWCAL allows users to monitor report and export schedules to see whether the operations were successful.

<div class="procedure">

To monitor the status of report and export schedules:

Go to **Reports** \> **Report Scheduler** \> **Status**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 581;height: 440;" />

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Reports Tab">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Reports Tab Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Reports Tab">

The following items are available on the Reports tab:

- **Scheduled Reports** - The Scheduled Reports tab shows all of the report schedules that are currently configured.

- **Successful Reports** - When a schedule is completed, the schedule will display under this tab. The screen displays the time when the schedule ran and when it succeeded.

- **Failed Reports** - If the schedule fails, it will display on the Failed Reports tab. Common reasons for a schedule to fail are:
  - You do not have permissions to the directory you were attempting to write to.
  - An email address was not entered correctly.

- **Crystal Errors** - Crystal-related errors will display on this tab.

  If you want to create a custom report, you will need to purchase a Crystal Reports Developer license. A Crystal license is not required if you are only running reports.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Exports Tab">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Exports Tab Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Exports Tab">

The following items are available on the Exports tab:

- **Scheduled Exports** - The Scheduled Exports tab shows all of the export schedules that are currently configured.
- **Successful Exports** - When a schedule is completed, the schedule will display under this tab. The screen displays the time when the schedule ran and when it succeeded.
- **Failed Exports** - If the schedule fails, it will display on the Failed Exports tab. Common reasons for a schedule to fail are:
  - You do not have permissions to the directory you were attempting to write to.
  - An email address was not entered correctly.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Function Buttons">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Function Buttons</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Function Buttons">

The following functions are available on the Report and Export Scheduler Information screen:

- **Delete** - Remove a schedule.
- **Activate** - Enable a schedule that has been put on hold.
- **Hold** - Disengage a schedule that is ready to run.
- **Run Now** - Set the schedule to run during the next scheduler iteration.
- **Refresh** - Update the screen to display new, successful or failed schedules.
- **Exit** - Close the Report and Export Scheduler Information screen.

</div>
